name: Inspector

props.description: Header actions (ghost sm buttons), before the close button.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: fill
props.description:
The child fills the body edge to edge and scrolls itself: a ConversationLog, which brings
its own scroller, floating composer and ask dock. Default: a padded scrolling column.

props.name: footer
props.description: Pinned to the bottom (a composer, a primary action).

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon element without an explicit size; the component sizes it through its tokens.
